```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "parsed entity text">
  <!ENTITY % pent "<!ELEMENT internal (#PCDATA)>">
  %pent;
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top level document comment -->
  <?target-pi processing instruction data="value"?>
  <child ns2:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with entities &ent; inside ]>
  </child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY % extDTD SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %extDTD;
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog section comment -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <book xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[ Book description by &author; ]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE notes [
  <!ELEMENT notes (note)+>
  <!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % base "http://example.com/">
  <!ENTITY greeting "Hello World">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<notes xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Detailed notes comment block -->
  <?xml-pix processing-instruction-data?>
  <note html:id="test">
    <![CDATA[ &greeting; inside CDATA block with <tags> & symbols ]>
  </note>
</notes>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % entityDecl "<!ENTITY secEnt 'Section Entity'>">
  %entityDecl;
  <!ENTITY testEnt "Test &secEnt;">
]>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://example.org/math">
  <!-- Document comment with multiple lines -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
  <m:section>
    <![CDATA[ Section content with &testEnt; ]>
  </m:section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemRef "Item Reference">
  <!ENTITY % localParams "<!ENTITY paramEnt 'Parameter Entity Value'>">
  %localParams;
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <?xml-processing-instruction key="value"?>
  <item xi:parse="text">
    <![CDATA[ Inventory CDATA section containing &itemRef; and ¶mEnt; ]>
  </item>
</inventory>
```
